title: The in-between move
line: Before recapturing, a stronger move first.

steps.text: White grabbed a pawn with the knight, Black took the knight, and White's bishop has just taken Black's queen.
Do not take back yet. First check the king with your bishop.

wrong.e8d8: That takes the queen back, but White stays a knight and a pawn ahead.

steps.hint: Your bishop can check along the diagonal to the white king.
steps.after: The only way out was to put the queen in the way.
The check came first, and Black ends a piece ahead.

summary: Before you take back, ask whether a check or threat comes first. The recapture can wait one move.
